- Support payroll administration, staff expenses and year-end preparation where required.
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
- Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, reporting and financial controls.

About you:

We are looking for someone with strong practical bookkeeping experience who can work independently and manage their workload with accuracy and confidence.

- Proven hands-on bookkeeping experience.
- Practical experience using both Sage Cloud and Xero.
- A good understanding of nominal ledger coding, journals and bank reconciliations.
- Experience processing invoices and managing customer and supplier accounts.
- Knowledge of VAT, including the ability to identify relevant VAT treatments.
- Confident Microsoft Excel skills and good general IT ability.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation and communication skills.
- A proactive approach and the ability to take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities.

title: Receptionist
description: We are a welcoming, patient-focused GP practice with a friendly and supportive team environment. We pride ourselves on creating a positive place to work, where colleagues support one another, work together and are valued for the important role they play in delivering high quality care to our patients. The role is busy, varied and often demanding, so it is important that applicants understand the pace and challenges of working in a GP practice. Our reception team is often the first point of contact for patients and plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth running of the practice. No two days are quite the same, and the ability to remain calm, organised and professional when managing competing demands is essential. The role As a Receptionist, you will be the friendly and professional first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals, providing an efficient, helpful and welcoming service. Your responsibilities will include: Acting as the first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Managing a high volume of incoming telephone calls and patient enquiries. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments. Dealing with patient queries sensitively, professionally and efficiently. Maintaining accurate patient records and ensuring confidentiality at all times. Helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. The person we are looking for We are looking for someone who is approachable, compassionate and professional, with excellent communication and organisational skills. The successful candidate will: Have a friendly and positive manner, with a genuine desire to help people. Be confident communicating with a wide range of people, including those who may be anxious, upset or frustrated. Be able to remain calm, patient and professional under pressure. Have the ability to prioritise and manage competing demands in a busy environment. Be reliable, flexible and able to work both independently and as part of a team. Have good IT and keyboard skills. Demonstrate discretion and understand the importance of patient confidentiality. Job Title: Receptionist Responsible to: Deputy Practice Manager Accountable to: Practice Manager Contract: Fixed Term Maternity Cover Location: The Family Medical Centre Job Purpose The Receptionist is the first point of contact for patients and visitors to the practice and plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the practice. The post holder will provide a professional, friendly and helpful reception service, dealing with patients face-to-face, by telephone and through other communication channels. They will support patients in accessing the appropriate services and ensure that enquiries are dealt with sensitively, efficiently and in a timely manner. Working as part of the wider administrative and reception team, the post holder will support GPs, Nurses, the Advanced Clinical Practitioner and the wider multidisciplinary team in delivering high quality patient care. The role requires someone who is organised, approachable and able to remain calm and professional in a busy and often demanding environment. Flexibility, initiative and the ability to manage competing priorities are essential. Key Responsibilities and Duties Reception and Patient Services Welcome patients and visitors to the practice in a friendly, professional and courteous manner. Act as the first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly, dealing with enquiries appropriately and directing calls to the relevant person or service. Manage appointment bookings, amendments and cancellations in accordance with practice procedures. Assist patients in accessing the most appropriate service, following practice protocols and guidance. Handle patient enquiries sensitively, particularly where patients may be distressed, anxious, frustrated or upset. Maintain a calm and professional approach when dealing with challenging situations. Ensure that patients are treated with dignity, respect and confidentiality at all times. Provide information about practice services, opening times and available clinics. Administrative Duties Maintain accurate patient records and update information using the clinical computer system. Manage prescription related enquiries and direct requests to the appropriate team member. Process requests for medical records and other administrative information in accordance with practice policies. Monitor and manage administrative tasks allocated to the reception team, including SystmConnect. Ensure messages are recorded accurately and passed to the appropriate member of staff. Assist with general administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Teamwork and Communication Work collaboratively with colleagues across the reception, administration and clinical teams. Communicate effectively with GPs, Nurses, Advanced Clinical Practitioner, the Practice Manager, Deputy Practice Manager and wider multidisciplinary team. Support colleagues during busy periods and assist with the effective distribution of workload. Attend team meetings and training sessions as required. Maintain positive working relationships and contribute to a friendly, supportive and professional working environment. Share relevant information with colleagues to ensure continuity and consistency of service. Confidentiality and Information Governance Maintain strict patient confidentiality at all times. Comply with GDPR, the Data Protection Act and practice confidentiality policies. Ensure patient information is handled securely and only accessed or shared where appropriate. Maintain awareness of information governance requirements and the importance of protecting sensitive patient information. Ensure computer screens, paperwork and patient records are kept secure. Health, Safety and Practice Responsibilities Follow all practice policies, procedures and protocols. Maintain a clean, tidy and welcoming reception and waiting area. Report any health and safety concerns, incidents or safeguarding concerns to the appropriate person. Be aware of and follow the practice's safeguarding procedures. Undertake mandatory and role specific training as required. Participate in appraisals and personal development activities. Carry out any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role and level of responsibility. This job description is intended to provide an outline of the main duties and responsibilities of the post. It is not exhaustive and may be reviewed and amended in consultation with the post holder in response to the changing needs of the practice.
